skills.name: AWS Local Manager infrastructure
skills.description: Sweeps the project for the AWS services it already uses, reading the code, the configuration and the .env files, then creates or repairs the infra/ folder that AWS Local Manager reads so the project can be debugged against the local AWS emulator.

pt-BR.name: Infraestrutura do AWS Local Manager
pt-BR.description: Varre o projeto atrás dos serviços AWS que ele já usa, lendo o código, as configurações e os arquivos .env, e então cria ou conserta a pasta infra/ que o AWS Local Manager lê, para o projeto poder ser debugado contra o emulador local da AWS.

en-US.name: AWS Local Manager infrastructure
en-US.description: Sweeps the project for the AWS services it already uses, reading the code, the configuration and the .env files, then creates or repairs the infra/ folder that AWS Local Manager reads so the project can be debugged against the local AWS emulator.
